reviews.title: New update…
reviews.text:
I tried opening the app only for it to tell me it needed an update. I went to check my updates, and it wasn’t there. After looking around, I found out I had to reinstall it entirely, even though I already had it downloaded. New app, I guess…?? 

When I finally got back in, it wouldn’t let me log in. I remember the email and password tied to the account, but I don’t remember my username, and apparently that wasn’t saved anywhere. I am unbelievably upset. This used to be my go to game, and now everything is lost.. It was super fun to play when it was actually playable, but now it isn’t. Luckily, I never made any in game purchases, but I genuinely feel bad for the people who did. I’m going to try reaching out for help, but all I’ve been hearing from other players is that nobody is getting a response. 😐

reviews.title: TOO HECTIC
reviews.text: I usually don’t leave these but DO NOT DOWNLOAD!!!! It seems fun and the graphics are great, but the battles are RIDICULOUS. They are rigged and keep lagging. Every time I run in an event, I clip through walls, the actions are delayed, and the shields don’t do ANYTHING. I have been stuck on a Dark War level after, I kid you not, 37 tries. And I still can’t even get halfway because there are so many enemies in one area that it gives you no time at all to even see what to do. There is so much on screen. We only have 6 HP and after like three hits we are dead. And when we revive, it usually revives right in front of an enemy, so we still get hit and lose HP. It is ridiculous on how much they charge for in app purchases. This app may seem great, but when you actually try to strategize, it is a nightmare. I wish there was a rating below one star.

reviews.title: I am astounded
reviews.text:
I have played many mobile games like this before and this is no doubt the best most polished one I’ve ever seen. This game is legitimately difficult unlike a lot of games like this that are frustratingly easy, so it feels like an accomplishment to pass the harder levels, but it’s not impossible. Very good mechanics.

The animation is incredibly polished and there was obviously a lot of work that went into all the items and animations and I’ve never seen a mobile game that centers around actual gameplay with this many customization options and it’s super fun to unlock things.

The mechanics are smooth and the levels are interesting and colorful. A detail I like is that you can customize your swing animation at the beginning which I’ve never seen before. I just started playing today and I’m really excited to keep playing. Nothing about it is confusing, and Code V is a very endearing tutorial character.

Not only is this game super fun and unique, but IT NEVER PUSHES ADS ON YOU!!!!! This is so incredible to me that I can’t even fully believe it. This game is really quality and really fun and the fact that it literally never forces ads on you is amazing. You can choose to watch ads to get certain upgrades and stuff but it’s never the default like with 99% of mobile games that try to be like this. It doesn’t have super long ads either and the ad placement makes total sense.

I love everything about this game. There isn’t too many options for customization, and there isn’t too little. It’s the perfect combination of mobile-game-esk game play and item collection without a ton of complicated stat management. You developers just made my day. You’re doing an amazing job and your game makes me so happy. I can see myself getting very invested in this game. Thank you! :D

reviews.title: Kinda neat, but...
reviews.text:
So, I found the game from an ad and it seemed really neat with character customizations.  First things first, it’s too close to Harley Quinn (there’s even a “casual” outfit that’s literally her costume) and the clown bad guy named Joker???  Naming him “Giggles the Clown” would’ve been better.  Only difference is that you’re enemies with him.  Battles are fairly simple, just run, defeat the joker clowns, and get coins/exp/outfits.  My second issue is quite a big one, in character customizations, there’s a white and a darker brown skin tone option available.  Doris does a little animated reaction to every skin change (feline stripes, void color, etc) but: why is the difference between the white animation and the brown animation so drastic???  When you choose the white skin, Doris is simply leaning against the side of the screen and moves towards the center, where her weapon then drops as she catches it.  WHEN YOU CHANGE TO THE DARK SKIN TONE: she does this certain almost-fortnite kind of dance, strikes a pose with a hand on her hip and a thumbs down before her weapon drops.  Are they trying to make it more “gangster”????  Very concerning with the difference, and multiple people I’ve talked to had agreed once I showed them.  Third of all, this game is stated for ages 12 and up, kindly change that because this is not okay for 12 year olds, especially ones with a more imaginative mindset.  Skimpy outfits galore, I swear.  Several of them are quite funny and completely fine, but the majority of Doris’ outfits seem to be tight fitted/crop top/short shorts style.  They make skimpy outfits, such as the punk outfit (literally a teeny triangle bikini looking top and her low cut shorts), seem just fine, cause oh!  It’s just a fun clothing choice!/s Yeah, it looks really cool, but what happens when people continue to over-sexualize video-game characters?? I’m 17.  I’m not even an adult and I find it all disturbing.  On a lesser note, even if it’s a game meant for 12+, there’s surprisingly a ton of casino ads, which really isn’t the kind of thing that should be advertised to kids/teens.  I get that it’s a paid source of income for the game but cmon, at least raise the age limit to make it a LITTLE more understandable.

While the storyline is rather plain and most costumes are “sexy,” the character and costume patterns/designs itself are really well put together, I’m aiming for the Hunter outfit myself.  Graphics are pretty neat, too!  It has a wide variety of aesthetic clothes and really funny weapons, such as a wiggling shark, an egg frying pan, or a minecraf- I mean pixeled, pickaxe.  There’s a few moments within the game that are very hard for me since I have attention/processing issues; occasionally, the enemies could be placed with a front, side, AND flying enemy extremely close together.  The game can move really fast, which is fun if there’s regular enemies.  Clumped ground enemies are fine, just the mix of ground + flying so close together is a big trouble for me to try and figure out.

It’s a neat game for a “subway surfers” vibe, with added “coolness” with slashing and defeating enemies.  I’d say it’d be alright to try, but know what you’re getting into and expect a lot of sexualized, skimpy outfits.  I wouldn’t outright recommend.  I’d give it 3 or 4 stars but a bunch of the more serious issues I wrote about just ruins a lot of it for me.
